system.description:
• Effect: Once per encounter, when you or an ally you can see within 60ft would take damage, you may pass it to a creature under your Hex.
  • It makes a Will save: on a failure it takes the damage instead; on a success the damage falls where it was aimed.
  • This needs no action.
  • Cauldron of the Ninth Moon improves: once a month, on any night.
  • Hex improves: a creature makes its first save against your Hex with Disadvantage.
